pairs: it would be advisable / it would be better

exercises.question: Which sentence gives hypothetical advice? [¿Cuál frase da un consejo hipotético?]
options: Si yo fuera tú, hablaría con el profesor. [If I were you, I would speak to the teacher.]
Habla con el profesor. [Speak to the teacher.]
Tienes que hablar con el profesor. [You have to speak to the teacher.]

exercises.sentence: Si yo fuera tú, __ con ella antes de decidir. [If I were you, I would speak to her before deciding.] (hablar)

exercises.english: If I were you, I would look for a safer alternative.

sentences: Primero pensaría en las consecuencias. [First I would think about the consequences.]
Después compararía las opciones. [Then I would compare the options.]
Por último, elegiría la más prudente. [Finally, I would choose the most sensible one.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: Estoy pensando en aceptar el trabajo.

options: Si yo fuera tú, leería el contrato primero. [If I were you, I would read the contract first.]
Si yo fuera tú, leí el contrato ayer. [If I were you, I read the contract yesterday.]
Si yo fuera tú, leeré el contrato mañana. [If I were you, I will read the contract tomorrow.]

exercises.question: What does «convendría esperar» mean? [¿Qué significa «convendría esperar»?]
options: It would be advisable to wait. [Sería aconsejable esperar.]
You had to wait. [Tenías que esperar.]

exercises.sentence: En tu lugar, __ antes de responder. [In your position, I would wait before answering.] (esperar)

exercises.english: I would not take the risk without more information.

exercises.sentence: Si yo fuera tú, esperaría antes de decidir.
options: If I were you, I would wait before deciding.
If I were you, I would decide immediately.
If I were you, I had waited before deciding.

exercises.sentence: En tu lugar, buscaría una alternativa más prudente.

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: Tiene sentido, porque todavía puedo esperar.

options: Yo esperaría unos días antes de tomar una decisión. [I would wait a few days before making a decision.]
Yo esperé unos días antes de tomar una decisión. [I waited a few days before making a decision.]
Yo esperaré unos días antes de tomar una decisión. [I will wait a few days before making a decision.]

exercises.question: Which option sounds less direct? [¿Qué opción suena menos directa?]
options: Si yo fuera tú, buscaría otra opción. [If I were you, I would look for another option.]
Busca otra opción. [Look for another option.]
Tienes que buscar otra opción. [You have to look for another option.]

exercises.sentence: Conviene pensar antes de actuar; en tu lugar, yo __. [It is advisable to think before acting; in your position, I would wait.] (esperar)

template.prompt: Give hypothetical advice with «Si yo fuera tú».
template.answer: Si yo fuera tú, esperaría antes de decidir.

template.prompt: Give a second recommendation using the conditional.
template.answer: Buscaría una alternativa que fuera más segura.

template.prompt: Use «arriesgarse» to warn someone about a risk.
template.answer: Yo no me arriesgaría sin más información.
Sería más prudente esperar porque todavía no conocemos las consecuencias.
